milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the lime carpet (at spawn-relative offset 5,0,5) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the lime carpet'. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable visual range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the pig's pen area (pig summoned at spawn-relative offset 9,0,8) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the pig'. max_distance=10 is tighter than the carpet milestone to ensure the player has actually progressed past the carpet and is near the pen. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the pig.
